Alerts.NoPhysicalStores: Wizybot will consider the website inventory for each product.
Alerts.NotSynchronizedRecommendation: Technical recommendation: Shopify supports branch inventory tracking; you can activate this feature by following the official guide:
Alerts.NoConsiderStock: Wizybot will not be able to provide branch-specific inventory information for a product.
Alerts.NoConsiderStockQuestion: What should the bot respond if a customer asks about availability or inventory?
Alerts.AutomaticStock: Wizybot will automatically take inventory from all active locations.
Alerts.AlertForKams: A test is conducted to validate that the inventory displayed on the website matches the inventory reported by Wizybot. To do this, products are selected that include different scenarios: at least one with multiple variants and another that is out of stock. Then, it is verified that Wizybot correctly loads the available variants, reflects the actual stock, and accurately displays the prices and availability of each option.
